bifrost: bifrost_app::observable, bifrost_app::coding, bifrost_app::dispatch, bifrost_ui::observe, bifrost_ui::detect; Rust language and std (no Swift language)
summary: Swift is a programming language, so most of its docs (types, protocols, closures, Objective-C and C++ interop, Swift 6 concurrency checking) do not map to BifrOSt, whose apps are written in Rust. The library-level parts with a counterpart are observable values, Codable, GCD-style dispatch and data detection; actors, the Regex builder and Distributed actors have no counterpart.
